narrative_purpose: Depicts Kiri's spirit-tree seizure as an over-voltage event — a single nervous system meeting the signal density of a planetary network — making the 'cost' of deep network coupling visible.
subject: A young Na'vi girl underwater, her queue-tendril plugged into a glowing pale root of a submerged spirit tree. An intense surge of cyan-white light floods up the tendril from the root system into the back of her head, where it flares into a jagged, spiking magenta burst around her skull, her body arched and rigid as if convulsing. The tree's other roots visibly dim as the light concentrates into her, as though the network's energy is being funnelled into one small body.
scene: A moment of dangerous over-connection: peaceful blue network light turning into a violent magenta electrical burst where it enters a single brain.
camera: A three-quarter underwater view centred on the girl's head and the queue-junction where the surge enters.
light: Cool cyan-white network light rushing up the tendril; a hot jagged magenta flare at the girl's skull marking the overload; the surrounding roots dimming as their light drains toward her.
palette: Void-indigo water base, Pandora cyan-white in the surging light, alarming magenta confined to the seizure-burst at the head, dimming teal in the draining roots.
style: Painterly speculative-biology naturalist plate as a luminous schematic, hand-painted texture, not vector-flat.
